note: Q.80 a.1 ad 2 distinguishes the aspect under which an object is apprehended from that under which appetite relates to it as suitable or good. This distinguishes the route's intellectual appraisal from appetite. The passage supplies neither an instance of a divine bearer appraising a good under a form nor a reason that every qualifying divine intellect does so.
